//: MCP Tool Definitions — Derived from docs/specs/gen-bridge.yaml (single source of truth)
//note: Every tool.name here maps to an operationId in gen-bridge.yaml. Parameter shapes are projections of the API schema, not independent definitions.

tools.name: generateImage
tools.description: Submit an image generation job. Returns job_id for polling. Uses Krea 2 (NSFW), Klein 9B (edits), or FLUX dev depending on model param.

prompt.description: Generation prompt. For NSFW stills use natural-language photo briefs (not tag lists). Include: anatomy, lighting, skin texture.

model.description: Model: flux_dev → Krea/Klein lane, sdxl_turbo → fast iteration, sd15 → legacy

num_steps.description: Krea 2 sweet spot: 12. Klein 9B: 10. Default 20 for FLUX dev.

guidance_scale.description: Krea 2: cfg 1.0. Klein: cfg 1.0. Standard FLUX: 7.5.

seed.description: Seed for reproducibility. Omit for random.

talent_id.description: Associate result with a Talent record for identity tracking.

lora_model_id.description: LoRA model UUID to apply (architecture-locked to the selected model).

lora_strength.description: LoRA strength. Klein CoachBate penis: 0.75 MAX.

tools.name: generateVideo
tools.description: Submit a video generation job. Returns job_id for polling. Supports Wan 2.2 (fast LoRA lane) and H3 MiniMax (identity-locked production).

prompt.description: Video prompt. For H3: use 5-part format (integrated_multimodal_description, soundscape, music, AVOID). For Wan: subject→action→camera→style order.

model.description: wan_2_1 → fast LoRA iteration lane. h3 → MiniMax production (Ref2VA, SparseRef15, Motion Director).

num_frames.description: Frame count. H3 15s@24fps grid: use 226, 243, 260, or 277. 216 and 280 are INVALID.

num_steps.description: H3 standard: 8 steps. H3 turbo (LightX2V LoRA): 4 steps. Wan Lightning: 4+4 steps.

guidance_scale.description: H3 cfg: 1.0 (both turbo and non-turbo). Wan: 7.5 standard.

talent_id.description: Associate with Talent record for identity continuity.

reference_image_url.description: Reference image URL for I2V generation. Aspect ratio MUST match width/height.

lora_model_id.description: LoRA model UUID (architecture-locked: Wan LoRAs won't load in H3).

tools.name: generateCharacterSheet
tools.description: Generate a 4-view photorealistic character identity sheet (front, profile, 3/4, back) for episode-spanning identity continuity. Uses Krea 2 Identity Edit pipeline.

description.description: Full character description: appearance, style, key traits, scars, tattoos. Include: skin tone, hair, eyes, build, signature marks, wardrobe.

talent_id.description: Associate sheet with existing Talent record.

reference_image_urls.description: Reference image URLs for identity anchor (up to 5).

style.description: Visual style for the character sheet.

tools.name: startTraining
tools.description: Start a LoRA training job on a GPU worker. Requires a dataset manifest. Produces an architecture-locked LoRA model artifact.

dataset_manifest_id.description: UUID of the prepared dataset manifest (20-40 clean images recommended).

base_model.description: Base model architecture. LoRAs are architecture-locked: a FLUX LoRA won't load in Klein.

rank.description: LoRA rank. Recommended: 16 (Krea 2 Raw tuning) or 32 (detail-heavy).

trigger_word.description: Trigger word. ALL-CAPS convention for Krea (e.g., 'CBUNCT'). Lowercase for FLUX/SD.

talent_id.description: Auto-associate the trained LoRA with this Talent record.

tools.name: getJobStatus
tools.description: Poll a generation/training job's current status and result. Use this to check if generation completed and retrieve asset URLs.

job_id.description: Job UUID returned from generateImage, generateVideo, generateCharacterSheet, or startTraining.

tools.name: listJobs
tools.description: List generation/training jobs for the current tenant with optional filters by status and type.

tools.name: cancelJob
tools.description: Cancel a pending or running generation job.
